p = "tests/integration/test_admission.py"
s = open(p).read()

s = s.replace(
    "from baton_v12.integration.admission import admit_candidate",
    "from baton_v12.integration.admission import (admit_candidate,\n"
    "                                             resolved_account,\n"
    "                                             source_account,\n"
    "                                             source_submission)")

old = '''if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()'''
new = '''class SourceEligibilityIsNotResultFreshness(AdmissionCase):
    """W133117: the two questions `resolved_account` used to answer as one.

    W131409's defect is a submission that is exactly as accepted as it ever
    was being refused because ANOTHER Job integrated. Separating the two
    proofs is what lets that submission be reconciled into a new result
    instead of being told it is ineligible -- and `RefusalBeforeMutation`'s
    `test_stale_target_refuses` above is the other half of the same rule: the
    DIRECT import path keeps its exact-target requirement unchanged.
    """

    def resolved(self):
        return resolved_account(self.manager, self.jobs, self.authority,
                                line_id="line-1", proposal_id="proposal-1")

    def source(self):
        return source_account(self.manager, self.jobs, self.authority,
                              line_id="line-1", proposal_id="proposal-1")

    def test_a_moved_target_refuses_the_import_account_and_not_eligibility(self):
        fresh = self.resolved()
        self.current_target = "revision-2"
        refusal = self.refusal()
        self.assertIn("expected target revision", refusal.message)
        # The SAME account, member for member, after the refusal above.
        self.assertEqual(self.source(), fresh)
        self.assertEqual(self.source()["expected_target_revision"],
                         self.proposal["target"])

    def test_eligibility_still_proves_every_producer_it_ever_did(self):
        """The separation is not a weaker proof. Each of these refuses the
        source account exactly as it refuses the import account."""
        self.current_target = "revision-2"
        cases = (
            ("frozen result", self.frozen, "result_id", "result-other"),
            ("checkpoint", self.checkpoint, "checkpoint_digest", "sha256:x"),
            ("assignment", self.proposal["assignment_ref"], "participant",
             "baton.other"),
            ("job", self.job, "input_digest", "sha256:different"),
        )
        for what, document, member, value in cases:
            with self.subTest(what=what):
                prior = document[member]
                document[member] = value
                with self.assertRaises(ContractRefusal):
                    self.source()
                document[member] = prior
        for kind in tuple(self.receipts):
            with self.subTest(what=f"{kind} receipt"):
                held = self.receipts.pop(kind)
                with self.assertRaises(ContractRefusal):
                    self.source()
                self.receipts[kind] = held
        # And with nothing broken it answers, so the matrix above is not
        # passing because everything refuses.
        self.assertEqual(self.source()["proposal_id"], "proposal-1")

    def test_the_submission_operand_carries_the_objects_the_account_cannot(self):
        """`prepare_result` reconciles Git OBJECTS. The account carries
        content digests, which name the same candidate in another language."""
        self.current_target = "revision-2"
        evidence = self.accepted["evidence"]
        self.assertEqual(
            source_submission(self.manager, self.jobs, self.authority,
                              line_id="line-1", proposal_id="proposal-1"),
            {"authority_uuid": UUID_A, "work_id": WORK, "job_id": "job-1",
             "line_id": "line-1",
             "source_checkpoint_id": "checkpoint-1",
             "source_verdict_id": "verdict-1",
             "source_proposal_id": "proposal-1",
             "source_result_id": "result-1",
             "source_result_digest": self.frozen["manifest_digest"],
             "source_checkpoint_digest": self.accepted["checkpoint_digest"],
             "source_base": evidence["base"],
             "source_candidate": evidence["head"]})

    def test_neither_source_answer_touches_the_coordinator(self):
        self.current_target = "revision-2"
        self.source()
        source_submission(self.manager, self.jobs, self.authority,
                          line_id="line-1", proposal_id="proposal-1")
        self.unchanged()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()'''
assert old in s
s = s.replace(old, new)
open(p,"w").write(s)
print("ok")
